content.bridge_context: Following the first farmers, we explore the rise of the first advanced civilizations in the Indus Valley, known for their planned cities and drainage systems.

units.title: Harappan Civilization
units.explanation: Around 4700 years ago, cities like Harappa and Mohenjodaro developed. They had a Citadel (high part) and a Lower Town.
units.dual_language_instruction: Identify characteristics of a planned city. / योजनाबद्ध शहर की विशेषताओं की पहचान करें।

units.title: Town Planning and Drainage
units.explanation: These cities had straight roads, covered drains with inspection holes, and houses with separate bathing areas.
units.dual_language_instruction: Compare Harappan drainage with modern ones. / हड़प्पा की जल निकासी की तुलना आधुनिक जल निकासी से करें।
